overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when the Chair's serial phone calls to members about waiving building fees amounted to deliberation outside a posted meeting; no further action was ordered, only a caution.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting through serial phone calls by the Chair to members on April 2 and 4, 2014, about waiving building permit fees.
allegations.key_passage: Gauging members' interest in a proposal prior to its introduction at a meeting constitutes active solicitation of an opinion of a Board member.
